name: Durock T1
description: Heavy premium tactile with a sharp, pronounced bump near the top of the stroke, shipped factory pre-lubed. The nylon housing keeps sound muted and deep; the wide actuation-to-bottom-out spread gives deliberate feedback that builders often compare to the Topre experience at a fraction of the cost. Any supplemental lube should stay on the housing rails only — over-lubing the bump face flattens the switch's signature bump.
